reader_usefulness.basis:
Read the entire original task, effective requirements, empty scope decisions, and current complete report in consecutive line ranges 1–55, 56–110, 111–165 and 166–220. The report supplies a usable decision method rather than a universal leaderboard winner. Dataset, framework, harness and leaderboard are introduced before comparison; the coverage matrix makes population and unit differences visible. Worked examples explain a genuine ranking reversal under broader coding tests, changed tau aggregation, pass@k versus pass^k, and preference sensitivity without equating unlike percentages. The reproducibility tables distinguish inspection, rescoring, new inference and actual replication and explicitly expose unavailable historical identities. Support recommendations distinguish explanation, retrieval, transactions and user-guided actions; repository recommendations use the deployed model–agent–tool configuration and include correction work. Meaningful contrary evidence and cost/operational qualifications appear next to the decisions they affect. No concrete reader-usefulness correction is required. This is a complete textual reader-usefulness assessment, not a fresh source audit or benchmark run.

Current-version reassessment: The revised tau description consistently includes both final database state and required response information. Its explicit skipped-confirmation blind spot is carried into the account-action recommendation and table, so readers can distinguish a rewarded outcome from a properly authorized trajectory. Historical attempted-task costs keep simulator expense separate and are not presented as current successful-task cost. EvalPlus adds output limits, code extraction and timeout conditions without changing the original-versus-expanded-test comparison. These additions sharpen what the benchmarks can support and remain consistent with the two deployment decisions. No new reader-usefulness defect found. All differences between the frozen reports were compared, and every changed passage plus the displayed surrounding context was actually read. Unchanged complete reading is reused from this same context; this is not a new factual audit or experiment.
